name: Floating Cart Product For Woocommerce
author: silverplugins217

sections.description:
Floating Cart Product For WooCommerce is the WooCommerce side cart plugin to instantly show customers their cart in a beautiful floating slide-out panel — without ever leaving the page.

When a customer clicks “Add to Cart”, the WooCommerce floating cart slides open automatically, displaying all cart items, quantities, totals, and a checkout button. This reduces cart abandonment and boosts conversion rates on your WooCommerce store.

🌟 Documentation | 🌟 Get Pro | 🌟 Live Demo | 🌟 Support

Why Use Floating Cart Product For WooCommerce?

A WooCommerce side cart keeps shoppers on your product pages longer. Instead of being redirected to the cart page on every add-to-cart click, customers see a sleek floating cart drawer — and keep shopping. The result: more items added, fewer abandoned carts, and higher revenue.

Key Features

Cart Display & Behaviour
* Floating cart opens automatically when a product is added to cart
* Show cart basket on all pages or only selected pages
* Side cart position: Left or Right
* Hide cart icon on Cart / Checkout pages
* Hide cart basket on specific pages by Page ID
* If cart is empty, the cart basket icon is hidden automatically
* Enable / Disable cart icon independently

Product Management Inside Cart
* Increase / Decrease product quantity directly inside the slide-out cart
* Remove products from the cart with one click
* View cart in loop layout with a quantity input box
* Basket count type: by number of products or total quantity of all products
* Basket counter position and color customization

Coupon & Discounts
* Enable / Disable coupon field inside the floating cart
* Enable / Disable coupon field on mobile devices
* Customizable coupon sticker color and style
* Apply coupon toast notification with custom color

Free Shipping Bar
* Free shipping progress bar with custom color
* Show / Hide free shipping notification

Product Slider (Upsell / Cross-sell)
* Enable / Disable product slider on Desktop and Mobile view
* Customize product slider title text

Checkout Buttons & Links
* View Cart, Checkout, and Continue Shopping buttons — all customizable
* Customize Cart, Checkout, and Continue Shopping links
* Footer button settings: background color, text color, margin, and row style

Header & Cart Styling
* Customize header cart icon and close icon with color and show/hide options
* Cart heading font size and font color customization
* Product title size customization for the side cart
* Delete icon color customization

Mobile & Responsive
* Fully mobile friendly
* Enable / Disable floating cart on mobile devices

Advanced & Developer Features
* Enable / Disable trigger to open cart by custom CSS class
* View Shipping, Discount, Tax, and full cart total in the slide-out cart
* WPML Support for multilingual WooCommerce stores
* Easy setup — no coding required

Who Is This Plugin For?

This WooCommerce floating cart plugin is perfect for:

  • eCommerce store owners who want to reduce cart abandonment
  • WooCommerce developers who need a fully customizable side cart
  • Agencies building client stores that require a polished, fast checkout flow
  • Any store wanting a modern Ajax side cart for WooCommerce

CONTRIBUTE AND TRANSLATE

Floating Cart Product For WooCommerce is translated into multiple languages including Chinese, Dutch, Russian, Spanish, and many more. Help make the plugin available in your language by contributing a translation on the WordPress translation platform.

Translate Floating Cart For WooCommerce
sections.installation:
1. Upload the floating-cart-product-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly from the WordPress plugin directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Floating Cart to configure general settings, custom styles, and translations.
  4. That’s it! The floating cart will appear automatically when customers add products to their cart.
sections.faq:
How does the WooCommerce floating cart work?

When a customer clicks “Add to Cart” on any product page, the plugin automatically opens a side cart drawer. Customers can view all cart items, update quantities, remove products, apply coupons, and proceed to checkout — all without leaving the current page.

Can I show the cart basket on specific pages only?

Yes. You can choose to display the cart basket on all pages or restrict it to selected pages. You can also hide it on specific pages by entering the Page ID in the settings.

Does the floating cart work on mobile devices?

Yes. The plugin is fully mobile responsive. You can also enable or disable the floating cart independently for mobile devices from the settings panel.

Is the plugin compatible with WPML?

Yes, the plugin fully supports WPML for multilingual WooCommerce stores.

Can I customize the cart colors and fonts?

Absolutely. From the Custom Style settings tab, you can customize cart heading font size, font color, product title size, button colors, free shipping bar color, coupon sticker color, delete icon color, close icon color, and much more.

Does the plugin support coupon codes?

Yes. You can enable a coupon input field inside the floating cart for both desktop and mobile. Customers can apply coupons directly from the cart drawer.

Where can I find the documentation?

Full documentation is available at plugin999.com.
